title: Retire the journal-free legacy import branch that hashes selected task bodies, refusing with an explicit rebuild instead
outcome: Retire the journal-free legacy import branch that hashes selected task bodies, refusing with an explicit rebuild instead
acceptance: Every live data branch (Engram, TermAl and Comovo hosts) is confirmed to carry the import journal, or is rebuilt, before the branch is removed

Import of a journal-free legacy head no longer hashes task bodies against stored byte digests (src/task_sync/git/delta/written.rs and the legacy calls in src/work_service/task_sync_folder_import.rs); it refuses with a typed reason that names the explicit rebuild as the remedy
A behaviour test shows the journal-free legacy head refuses with that reason and remedy, and an ordinary journal-backed import is unchanged
